context: This criteria evaluates the implementation of automatic retry logic for failed requests, including basic retry count configuration and custom retry condition callbacks.

checklist.name: Basic retry configuration
checklist.description: Correctly configures automatic retries using the retry method with a retry count

checklist.name: Custom retry callback
checklist.description: Implements custom retry logic using a callback function that receives error and response to determine whether to retry

checklist.name: Retry tracking
checklist.description: Demonstrates awareness of retry behavior and tracks retry attempts
